anomalies.description: A woman is shown with a rope tightly bound around her mouth and neck (gagged), seated and restrained; in the background, a man approaches her while she remains immobilized.; A woman is gagged and restrained, visibly distressed, while a man stands nearby; she is then struck or thrown violently (head snap at f4), indicating physical abuse.
Two men engage in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat: one grabs the other’s throat/neck (f9), they grapple and exchange blows (f10–f14), with visible strikes and defensive maneuvers.
A woman is shown gagged with a dark cloth tied around her mouth and neck, appearing distressed and helpless in a dimly lit setting.
A bearded man in a leather jacket grabs another man by the head/neck and forcefully pushes him against a wooden structure; the victim appears restrained or subdued.

A man in the foreground delivers a forceful right-handed punch to another man's face, causing visible impact and spray (likely saliva or blood).; Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat: one delivers a punch or strike to the other’s head/face, causing visible impact and motion blur.
The two men are engaged in close-quarters physical combat; the attacker follows up with additional strikes while the other is reeling, with motion blur indicating rapid movement.
Continued hand-to-hand fighting: one man grabs the other’s head/neck and delivers multiple blows, including a visible strike to the face at f15, in a dimly lit interior setting.
Two men engage in a close-quarters physical fight involving grappling, striking, and shoving in a dimly lit interior space.

Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat: one (bearded, leather jacket) grabs and shoves the other (older man, dark coat), who is pushed backward against shelves; the struggle continues with grappling and forceful contact.
A woman is shown gagged with cloth and bound with rope, held captive and helpless, indicating abuse.
A woman is shown bound and gagged, with rope around her neck and a black cloth gag over her mouth; she appears restrained and helpless, looking off-camera with fear or distress.

A woman is bound with rope around her neck and torso, gagged, and held captive in a dimly lit interior; she appears distressed and helpless while another person (partially visible) interacts aggressively with her and others in the background.
A close-up shows hands bound with rope and what appears to be a metal restraint (possibly a shackle or handcuff); the wrists are tightly secured, indicating captivity and coercion.
The two men resume physical struggle in a dimly lit space; one man (bearded) appears to overpower the other, who is bent over and being held or struck; motion blur suggests rapid movement and impact.

A bearded man in a leather jacket is seen grabbing and restraining another man who is seated and appears helpless; the victim's mouth is gagged with cloth and he is bound with rope, indicating non-consensual restraint and abuse.

The restrained victim remains in a seated, helpless position while the aggressor stands over them; the victim shows signs of distress (open mouth, wide eyes), indicating ongoing coercion or intimidation.
